name: MonarchWorldMap
title: WorldMap
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas with androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.detectTapGestures and androidx.compose.ui.layout.Layout for the TalkBack elements, inside MonarchChartFrame
summary: Values by country on a simplified world map, as a choropleth in one data color with a Less to More legend or as bubbles sized by value, inside a chart frame with a data table.
whenToUse: To show how a measure spreads across countries (signups, workspaces, revenue by country) when the geography matters to the reader.
whenNotToUse: For an exact ranking or fewer than about five countries use MonarchBarList or MonarchBarChart, which compare lengths more precisely than shades. For navigation, addresses or anything below country level use a map SDK; this outline is simplified and not for navigation.
api: @Composable fun MonarchWorldMap(title: String, data: List<MonarchWorldMapDatum>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Ready, variant: MonarchWorldMapVariant = MonarchWorldMapVariant.Choropleth, color: MonarchChartColor = MonarchChartColor.Data1, thresholds: List<Double>? = null, extras: List<MonarchWorldMapExtra> = emptyList(), showLegend: Boolean = true, summary: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, footer: String? = null, countryName: ((String) -> String)? = null, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onSelect: ((MonarchWorldMapDatum) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchWorldMapLabels = MonarchWorldMapLabels())
class MonarchWorldMapDatum(country: String, value: Double, details: List<MonarchWorldMapDetail> = emptyList())
class MonarchWorldMapExtra(label: String, value: Double, key: String = label)

class MonarchWorldMapLabels(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), country: String? = null, value: String? = null, extras: String? = null, less: String? = null, more: String? = null, rangeBelow: String? = null, range: String? = null, rangeAbove: String? = null, select: String? = null, unplaced: ((names: String, total: String) -> String)? = null, summary: ((countries: Int, top: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The chart's name, shown as the frame's heading. Already localised.

options.name: data
options.description: One value per ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, with optional detail lines. Codes are trimmed and upper-cased; a later entry for the same code wins; values that are not finite are left out.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title, such as the period.

options.name: status
options.description: Map, loading skeleton, empty state or error. A ready map without values or extras shows the empty state.

options.name: variant
options.description: Filled countries, or bubbles whose area grows with the value on a neutral map.

options.name: color
options.description: The data color of the steps or bubbles.

options.name: thresholds
options.description: Three ascending values where levels 2, 3 and 4 start. Quarters of the largest value when null.

options.name: extras
options.description: Values that belong to no country ("Global", "EU"), shown as tiles under the map and as table rows.

options.name: showLegend
options.description: Shows the Less to More legend under a choropleth.

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated summary that names the map for TalkBack.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart, such as the source.

options.name: countryName
options.description: Names a country from its code. The default is the region's name in the current locale (java.util.Locale.getDisplayCountry), then the code.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes a value. The default is android.icu.text.NumberFormat in the current locale.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with a country's cleaned datum when it is tapped or chosen with the TalkBack Select action, for drill-in.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the chart frame's.

states.name: choropleth
states.description: Every country with a value is filled with its level: the muted background for zero or less, three mixes of the data color and the color itself; countries without a value stay muted. Countries too small for the outline get a dot in their level's color.

states.name: bubble
states.description: The map stays muted and each country with a value gets a circle whose area grows with the value, filled with a quarter of the data color over the surface and outlined in the data color. No legend.

states.name: country inspected
states.description: A tapped country is outlined (or its dot or bubble is outlined and, for a bubble, filled more strongly) in the default text color, marked selected for TalkBack, and its name, value and details are written under the map and announced politely. A tap on the sea clears it.

states.name: extras and unplaced codes
states.description: Values for no country are tiles under the map; codes the outline does not have are listed in a muted note with their total.

states.name: table
states.description: View as table lists one row per country, largest first, then one per extra, with the value and one column per detail label.

states.name: loading
states.description: The frame's skeleton, read as Loading chart.

states.name: empty
states.description: The frame's empty state, when the map is ready without any value or extra.

states.name: error
states.description: The frame's error message, with Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: Countries are the muted background separated by thin surface-coloured lines. Choropleth levels mix the chosen data color into the muted background at a quarter, half and three quarters, then use the color itself, as the heatmap does. Bubbles mix a quarter of the data color into the surface with a data-color outline. The inspected country is outlined in the default text color; tiles use the subtle background with a subtle border, muted label and default value. All colors are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes keep five distinct steps.
platformNotes: Uses the same Natural Earth 1:110m outline and centroids as the web's WorldMap, converted into an internal Kotlin source, with the same levels, bubble sizes, summary, legend and table. The web shows a floating tooltip on hover and steps through countries with the arrow keys; on Android a tap inspects a country and writes its details under the map. TalkBack users move through one element per country, largest value first, each with a Select action when onSelect is given; iOS makes the map one adjustable element instead, which Android has no equivalent for that is not a slider. Country elements are smaller than 48dp and overlap in Europe, so they are not buttons; a finger taps the map, and a tap that misses a small country finds the nearest country with a value within 24dp. The controlled activeCountry and onActiveCountryChange props and the web's valueFormat (Intl options) are not offered; use formatValue. The legend reuses the heatmap's Less, More and range strings. The map is never mirrored in right-to-left layouts.
accessibility: The map is a traversal group whose content description is the generated summary (for example "3 countries. Highest: United States 1,200, Germany 300, Singapore 40.") or the summary given, with collection info of the countries.

Every country with a value is its own TalkBack element on the country's center, read as "Germany: 300, Users 90", ordered largest value first by traversal index, with collection item info; the inspected country is marked selected.
With onSelect each country element has a Select custom action that inspects the country and calls onSelect; without it the elements have no action.
The details of the inspected country are a polite live region that is always present, so each new inspection is announced.
The legend is one element read as "Legend" and the range of every step, so the shades are never the only key.
The tiles are a traversal group named "Other values"; each tile is one element read as its label and value.
View as table lists every country, value and detail in rows TalkBack reads one at a time.
The map keeps its geography right to left; the text under it follows the layout direction.
edgeCases: Codes are trimmed and upper-cased; " de" and "DE" are the same country and the later entry wins.
Codes the outline does not know (an invalid code or a territory dropped by the 1:110m set) are listed under the map and still appear in the table and the summary.
Countries with a value but no outline (Singapore, Malta, Bahrain) are drawn as a dot at their centroid; in the bubble variant every country is a bubble.
Negative values are level 0 and the smallest bubble.
Russia and Fiji cross the 180th meridian; the map is clipped to its bounds.
Extras alone (no country values) show the tiles without a map.
The map keeps the 1000 by 394 aspect ratio, so it is short on a phone; small countries are best read through TalkBack, the details line or the table.

examples.title: Choropleth with details and extras
examples.template:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    MonarchWorldMap(
        title = {{title}},
        data = listOf(
            MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.0.country}}, {{countries.0.value|double}}, listOf(MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, "{{countries.0.users|raw}}"))),
            MonarchWorldMapDatum({{countries.1.country}}, {{countries.1.value|double}}, listOf(MonarchWorldMapDetail({{detailLabel}}, "{{countries.1.users|raw}}"))),

examples.title: Bubbles with drill-in
examples.code:
MonarchWorldMap(
    title = "Revenue by country",
    data = listOf(MonarchWorldMapDatum("GB", 82.0), MonarchWorldMapDatum("JP", 41.0)),
    variant = MonarchWorldMapVariant.Bubble,
    color = MonarchChartColor.Data2,
    formatValue = { "$${it.toInt()}k" },
    onSelect = { country = it.country },
)
